chunks: Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn ‘Īsā, from his father, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād, who said:
Abū al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him) asked me, “What do you recite in your salutation to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)?” I replied, “That which is known and which we have narrated.”
He said, “Shall I not teach you something that is better than this?” I said, “Yes, may I be your ransom.”
He wrote it for me while I was sitting, and read it to me, and said: “When you stand by his grave (peace be upon him), say:

I testify that there is no god but Allāh, He is alone, He has no partner, and I testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh, that Muḥammad is His slave and Messenger, and I testify that you are Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh, and I testify that you are the Seal of the Prophets.

And I testify that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord, advised your nation, strove in the way of your Lord, and worshipped Him until certainty (death) came to you, and you fulfilled what was upon you of the truth.

O Allāh! Send blessing on Muḥammad, Your slave, Your Messenger, Your confidant, Your trustee, Your chosen one, and the best of Your creation, (blessings which are) greater than any of the blessings You have sent on any of Your prophets or messengers.

O Allāh! Send Salām on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You sent Salām on Nūḥ among the worlds. Bestow favour on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You bestowed favour on Mūsā and Hārūn. And bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm. Verily You are the Praised, the Glorified.
O Allāh! Send blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad and have mercy on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad.
O Allāh! Lord of the Sacred House, Lord of the Sacred Mosque, Lord of the Rukn and Maqām, Lord of the Sacred Land, Lord of the lawful and the unlawful, Lord of al-Mash’ar al-Ḥarām.
Send my Salām to the soul of Your Prophet Muḥammad (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الرُّكْن: The Rukn (a specific part of the Kaaba)
key_terms.الْمَشْعَر: The Mash’ar (place of standing, e.g., at Arafat or Mina)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when visiting the grave of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Kāẓim (peace be upon him) provides a specific, detailed formula for salutation (taslīm) when standing at the grave of the Prophet Muḥammad (peace be upon him and his family). It uniquely emphasizes the Prophet's completion of his mission ('until certainty came to him') and links the invocation of blessings upon him and his Ahl al-Bayt to the patriarchal blessings of Noah, Moses, and Abraham, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine favor through the Prophet's household. The supplication concludes with a direct request to convey the salutation to the Prophet's soul, highlighting the belief in the spiritual presence of the Prophet even after his physical departure.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abil Bilād, who said:
Abul Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) asked me, “What do you recite in your salutation to the Prophet (s.a.a.w.)?” I replied, “I recite that which is known and (commonly) narrated.”
Imam (a.s.) asked, “Should I not teach you something that is better than that which you recite?” I replied, “Yes. May I sacrifice myself for you.”

As I was sitting there, Imam (a.s.) wrote the following with his own hands for me, and he also read it to me: When you are standing next to his (the Prophet’s (s.a.a.w.)) grave, recite (the following):              (s.a.a.w.)
I testify that there is no god but Allāh; He is alone and He has no partners, and I testify that Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.) is His slave and messenger.

I testify that you are Muḥammad, son of ‘Abdillāh, and that you are the last of the prophets. I testify that you announced the messages of your Lord, you advised your nation, you fought in the way of your Lord, and you worshipped Him until that which is certain (death) came to you. And you fulfilled your obligations.

O Allāh! Send Your blessing on Muḥammad, Your slave, Your messenger, Your confidant, Your trustee, Your chosen one, and the best of Your creation, (blessings which are) greater than any of the blessings You have sent on any of Your prophets or messengers.

O Allāh! Send (Your) Salām on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You sent Your Salām on Nūḥ “among the worlds.” Bestow Your favour on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You bestowed Your favour “on Mūsā and Hārūn.” And bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad just as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm. Verily You are the Praised, the Glorified.
O Allāh! Send blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad and have mercy on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad.                         .
O Allāh! O Lord of the Sacred House! O Lord of the Sacred Mosque! O Lord of RUKN and MAQĀM! O Lord of the Sacred Land! O Lord of the lawful and the unlawful! O Lord of MASH’AR AL-ḤARĀM!
Send my Salām to the soul of Muḥammad, Your Prophet.
